promptText:
You are the art director for the Eluminia game world map (a 2D painterly RPG for children). A new region is about to be painted by outpainting an existing map.

Direction of extension: south
New region theme: pont de pierre effondré enjambant la rivière, sentier forestier qui y aboutit

Required border continuities:
- (aucun connecteur déclaré sur ce bord dans world.json : à traiter comme une bordure fermée, prolonger le décor de clôture — forêt/falaise/rivière — plutôt que d'inventer une sortie)

Measured world constants (must be respected):
projection: top-down-three-quarter
camera direction: north-to-south
light: overhead-warm (warm-golden, saturation medium-high, soft, contact shadows only, no long cast shadows)
road width: ~175px
river width: ~135px
tree style: rounded painterly clusters, warm autumn palette (yellow-green to orange-brown), dark green pine accents, no individual leaf detail at this scale
river style: meandering, soft painterly reflections, light foam at banks, no whitewater
fence style: wooden, waist-height, light brown, used around gardens/plots only
level of detail: medium — readable at native 1:1 display, no fine texture detail expected to survive gameplay zoom

In 4-8 short bullet points, write a concise art-direction brief for this new region: what should be painted, which natural transition elements to use, what must be avoided, and any continuity risk specific to this direction/theme. Add judgment, do not just restate the constants above. Plain text bullets only, no markdown headers, no preamble.
